questions.q: Which formula expresses Newton's second law?
questions.why: The script states force equals mass times acceleration.

questions.q: A 10 kg box is pushed with 50 N while friction pulls back with 20 N. What is its acceleration?
questions.why: The net force is 30 N, and 30 N / 10 kg = 3 m/s².
